ROI.scope: Actual collector enable/disable anchors. A deferred ROI synchronizes its left boundary. Kernel union and gaps must be clipped to these GPU-clock anchors. Observer overhead is checked on the full clean/profile/clean serving trace.

kernels.scope: Kernel-name classification on actual CUDA activity. Unknown kernels remain UNKNOWN. Attention metadata is not the attention forward kernel. Fused Norm/residual is not divided. Union durations avoid double counting. Cross-category overlaps are separate. Projection subtypes cannot be recovered from a shared GEMM name. No GPU operator-to-request allocation is assumed.

path.name: PC_SamePairP_Hybrid_s1_Profile

credit.scope: Coordinator-window occupancy only. This is not actual GPU batch,KV capacity or hidden-slot ownership. Absent continuous pending-segment records are NOT_INSTRUMENTED,not zero waiting. Arrival→dispatch/full-window overlap is reconstructed from exact credit events and scheduled arrivals. It is a joint observed state,not exclusive causal credit wait. Coordinator enqueue can lag scheduled arrival. It does not establish physical GPU idle or causal speedup.

path.scope: Exact additive Arrival→P-ready time partition on the mapped GPU timeline,subject to the reported clock uncertainty. Single-request model-enclosure activity is associated with that forward,but lacks operator-to-request correlation. Concurrent kernels on other streams can enter the enclosure. Do not call it a correlation-verified exclusive request service. Shared-batch kernels remain unallocated. Other P kernels can belong to preceding requests or metadata/sampling outside the model-call scope. No P kernel is not proof of all-engine idle or a specific host cause. Waiting time is not exclusive service. The same kernel can delay many requests. Summed request waiting is not total GPU work. Clock uncertainty uses endpoint anchors and drift. It is not a formal bound on unobserved interior clock jitter.

observer_gate.scope: Full-trace clean/profile/clean5% gate on all five latency metrics. Exact per-request output lengths. All P queries are inside this full trace. This is one triplet,not a serving superiority CI.
